scope: wave002 coordinator dedup/normalization only; canonical execution queue remains docs/backlog.md
suggestion: Five concrete retained interventions can be considered for conditional research registration by Root; others remain local/deferred or merged. This suggestion is not assignment/admission.

entries.mechanism: QuerySetReduce: exclude the focal item and aggregate same-category co-candidate cart commitment, count and unresolved-context fraction.
entries.testable_prediction: A fixed-C world with unchanged focal W fields and pooled category control can change the rival max; any utility must survive the matched composite control and current W.
entries.nearest_experiment: Printed fixed-C witness plus top-two/self/tie/missing/mask closure; independently preserve C before any support scan.
entries.benefit_towardTask1: Extends the typed automation language to query-set reductions with explicit context, coverage and cost.
entries.nearest_overlap_and_delta: Distinct fixed scalar intervention from MB2-01 joint learner; same Set-Encoder motivation does not merge their treatments.

entries.mechanism: Compute strict-past24h harmonic means for user views/item purchases, then cross-entity alignment and common coherence/mask.
entries.testable_prediction: Equal counts, recencies and coherence can yield different alignment; whole24h outcomes may still make that phase irrelevant.
entries.nearest_experiment: Equal-coherence5/9→4/9 literal, exact numeric tolerance/dtype, W denominator proof, peer/boundary/mask and demanded-state contracts.
entries.benefit_towardTask1: Tests a typed weighted temporal aggregate and interaction beyond count/recency while isolating concentration.
entries.nearest_overlap_and_delta: Different from FB05 single-history roughness energies and repeat-waiting-time priors; explicit sin/cos basis algebraically subsumes it.

entries.mechanism: Summarize fixed32-bin strict-past activity with two normalized adjacent-scale count-contrast energies.
entries.testable_prediction: Matched totals/recencies/fixed2d-decay can differ in roughness; sparsity or phase artifacts can still explain all apparent utility.
entries.nearest_experiment: Exact histogram/endpoints/N0/N1/translation/phase and stronger fixed-decay witness; add physical-read/byte/wall bounds.
entries.benefit_towardTask1: Adds compact nonlinear temporal summaries under the same limited-column automation budget.
entries.nearest_overlap_and_delta: Distinct operator from FA06 two-entity phase interaction and FB01 action-path area; no new information beyond the full histogram.

entries.mechanism: Select a whole interest profile whose self-inclusive third-neighbor radius covers a majority of five eligible session prefixes.
entries.testable_prediction: Same equal-session mean/pooled counts can yield different selected profiles; emerging minority intent can make consensus harmful.
entries.nearest_experiment: Self-inclusive0,0,0,1,1 versus exclusive all1 negative fixture; session/peer/fewer-than-five/missing and physical-source closure.
entries.benefit_towardTask1: Adds a robust typed aggregation choice with a matched mean control and explicit history support.
entries.nearest_overlap_and_delta: Not audience concentration, row clipping or per-coordinate medians; source independence guarantees do not transfer to shopping sessions.

entries.mechanism: Use local Bayesian-linear descriptor uncertainty/UCB to allocate two additional proxy evaluations over a frozen typed-AST pool.
entries.testable_prediction: Equal predicted means with different variance change the acquisition; paired+1/−1 worlds defeat universal benefit and descriptor collisions remain distinct ASTs.
entries.nearest_experiment: Freeze exact proxy/bins/prior/UCB and information isolation; six shared initial scores plus two requests per arm imply16 logical exposures and≤10 unique physical calls.
entries.benefit_towardTask1: Tests adaptive automatic search efficiency while charging materialization/proxy information and every downstream fit.
entries.nearest_overlap_and_delta: Distinct local acquisition from FA01 pair synergy, FA02 family routing, FA03 shared search, FA04 macros and external selectorHYP014.

entries.mechanism: Discover valid item-code leaves through prefix-conditioned tree decoding with explicit beam/path/vocabulary lifecycle.
entries.testable_prediction: History-conditioned paths can differ from flat one-vector retrieval, but this is a decoding aspect of already retained MB04 generative item-code family.
entries.nearest_experiment: Exact tiny path/leaf/duplicate/dead-beam controls, mature identifier bank, preprocessing cost and immutable code/version freeze.
entries.benefit_towardTask1: Documents an implementation alternative and refusal gates for a transferable candidate operator without inflating the research count.
entries.nearest_overlap_and_delta: Merge under MB04 broad generative family; ActionPiece/ETEGRec directions are not extra mechanism registrations here.

entries.mechanism: Reverse a discrete item-replacement process with learned conditional preference ratios and an explicit valid transition law.
entries.testable_prediction: An asymmetric oracle distinguishes transpose errors that a uniform oracle misses; negative reverse mass blocks the uncorrected transition.
entries.nearest_experiment: Asymmetric8/15,13/30,1/30 oracle, reference-ranking flip and nonnegative stochastic-law check; count every inner catalogue projection.
entries.benefit_towardTask1: Tests a separate retrieval transition while making numerical validity and fullY/physical cost falsifiable.
entries.nearest_overlap_and_delta: Distinct from static tree decoding or dense ANN; clipping changes the law and is not a free numerical repair.

entries.mechanism: Train a permutation-equivariant masked numeric scorer that exchanges information across the entire existing candidate set.
entries.testable_prediction: Unchanged focal rows can reverse relative scores when other real candidates change; padding must not change keyed scores, and cheap mean/max context may explain all value.
entries.nearest_experiment: Zero-data masking/permutation and mean-max-attention witnesses, exact capacity/control/missing policy and full-set work ledger.
entries.benefit_towardTask1: Tests whether automated representations need candidate-set context and supplies a stronger comparison for fixed scalar generated context.
entries.nearest_overlap_and_delta: Related motivation to FA05 but joint learned forward computation differs from a predefined QuerySetReduce feature; not M05 history-event pooling.

entries.mechanism: Learn training-only error environments with XRM twins, then compare fixed group weighting against class-balanced and weighted-shuffled controls.
entries.testable_prediction: Nonempty class×environment groups do not identify useful environments; useful learned assignments must outperform a shuffle preserving exact query mass and support.
entries.nearest_experiment: Literal nondegenerate-but-uninformative environment, exact weighted shuffle and independent positive-user ESS/support contract.
entries.benefit_towardTask1: Tests automatic training-risk allocation without leaking label-dependent groups into inference or claiming causal invariance.
entries.nearest_overlap_and_delta: A separate automation axis from fixed query weights/TabM; static RWG adaptation is not the original full GroupDRO algorithm.

entries.mechanism: Generate bounded label-clamped local perturbations of real positive training rows while preserving query/class mass and deterministic feature closure.
entries.testable_prediction: Impossible pair>user counts are rejected; synthetics cannot create independent outcome evidence and may add no information beyond mass-matched duplicates.
entries.nearest_experiment: Source-free reverse-conditioning/mask/closure smoke with no CFG auxiliary model, explicit update/checkpoint and99-NFE branch accounting.
entries.benefit_towardTask1: Tests training-support regularization under finite costs while preserving real Q/C/fullY and user-based uncertainty.
entries.nearest_overlap_and_delta: Distinct from candidate generation or extra target data; author target-from-features imputation does not establish this reverse wrapper.

control_contract: Future feature/learner contrasts retain sameQ/C/fullY and eligible strongW baseline with paid matched controls; retrieval changesC and must report native and actual-size matched fullY coverage. No current015/018/report gate depends on these ideas.
paired_family_notes: FA05 fixed scalar and MB2-01 joint learner share candidate-context motivation, not the same intervention.
FA06 phase compatibility and FB05 roughness differ in entity grain and operator; no claim of extra information beyond a complete appropriate basis.
RA2-01 merges MB04 generative family rather than rediscovering a new family.
Nine local distinct proposals are not nine academic novelties or nine execution-ready experiments.
